description: The line plot illustrates the performance of four different methods—TACRED, TACRED-Revisit, Re-TACRED, and SemEval—measured by Micro F1 percentage across varying numbers of generated samples, specifically at K=8, K=16, K=32, and K=64. The x-axis, labeled "Number of Samples Generated," is a categorical scale with four distinct points, while the y-axis, labeled "Micro F1 (%)," ranges from 20 to 55 in increments of 5. The TACRED method, represented by a blue line with circular markers, shows a steady increase in performance from approximately 23% at K=8 to 29% at K=64. The TACRED-Revisit method, shown in orange with triangular markers, also increases from about 23% to 30%, peaking at K=32. The Re-TACRED method, depicted in green with diamond markers, exhibits the most significant improvement, rising from 35% at K=8 to a peak of 51% at K=32, before slightly declining to 48% at K=64. The SemEval method, represented by a red line with square markers, shows a consistent upward trend from 42% at K=8 to 52% at K=64. Overall, the Re-TACRED and SemEval methods achieve the highest Micro F1 scores, with Re-TACRED peaking at K=32 and SemEval showing the most consistent improvement across all sample sizes.
